mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (u_id, u_pwd, u_email, u_name, u_phone, u_birth, u_gender, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{uId}, #{uPwd}, #{uEmail}, #{uName}, #{uPhone}, #{uBirth}, #{uGender}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT u_id, u_email, u_name, u_phone, u_birth, u_gender, created_at, updated_at FROM users
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET u_name = #{uName}, u_phone = #{uPhone}, u_birth = #{uBirth}, u_gender = #{uGender}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE u_id = #{uId}
UPDATE users SET u_pwd = #{uPwd}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE u_id = #{uId}
